title: HS300 + ZZ500 + CSI1000 PIT 股票池扩展
primary_question: 在不改变排序因子、择时、退出、组合构建和 ETF 腿的前提下，把股票池从 HS300+ZZ500 扩展到 HS300+ZZ500+CSI1000，是否能改善 A 股个股腿表现，并且保持 PIT 可审计？
primary_variable: stock universe: HS300_ZZ500 -> HS300_ZZ500_CSI1000, PIT_DYNAMIC only
fixed_assumptions: single primary variable is stock pool expansion only
baseline variant keeps HS300_ZZ500 with PIT_DYNAMIC membership
candidate variant uses HS300_ZZ500_CSI1000 with PIT_DYNAMIC membership
no ranking factor, timing, fill rule, exit rule, risk budget, ETF leg, or portfolio construction change
stock-only research first; do not combine into stock+ETF portfolio until stock leg is auditable
CSI1000 provider floor and refresh coverage must be exposed before any performance conclusion
key_findings: OpenSpec、universe resolver、lineage、data bundle builder、study yaml 和生成脚本已经落地；Docker dry-run 已确认 A1 payload 使用 HS300_ZZ500_CSI1000 + PIT_DYNAMIC。
静态审计显示 CSI1000 PIT provider floor 为 2015-07-31；因此 2012-2017 与 2012-2026 的 CSI1000 段必须标记为 partial provider floor，不能当作完整 2012 起点 CSI1000 PIT。
1626 主窗口静态池规模：CSI800 1491 只，CSI1000 2632 只，union 3318 只，overlap 805 只，CSI1000 新增 1827 只。
1626 OHLCV 覆盖：union 3318 只中 3316 只有行情，2 只缺行情；窗口内 OHLCV 行数约 704.4 万，missing close 为 0。
A1_HS300_ZZ500_CSI1000 在 1626 全量运行被 OOM/exit 137 中断，只产出 run_config.json，没有 perf/run_meta；当前不能形成扩池收益结论。
按 1-4 顺序完成算法优化验收：PIT interval 行级裁剪因 B0 parity 漂移被否决并关闭；top-k partial selection 与跳过未使用昂贵评分矩阵通过 B0 parity，B0 总耗时从 199.967s 降至 118.227s。
安全等价优化后 A1 1626 仍 OOM/exit 137，说明阻塞点已经从普通排序/未使用评分转向宽股票池 dense matrix / simulation 容量问题。
新增 active-set sparse scoring、失败前 checkpoint profile，并跳过未启用的 pullback 候选矩阵后，B0 1626 parity 继续完全一致：exp_20260510_063251764_5c36，CAGR 14.31%，Sharpe 0.663，MaxDD -35.42%，trades 750。
A1 与 B0 的 effective_execution_start_date 都是 2016-07-08，主窗口同窗比较有效；但 CSI1000 membership_data_quality 仍为 approximate，provider floor 为 2015-07-31，跨 2012 窗口仍需 partial 标记。
next_actions: 不建议按当前口径继续推进 HS300+ZZ500+CSI1000 直接扩池，也不升级 baseline，不接入组合腿。
下一阶段如果继续研究个股腿，应先做扩池负贡献归因：新增 CSI1000 标的成交、行业、市值/流动性、入选排名与亏损集中分析。
如需继续三窗口，只能作为失败归因审计，不作为候选升级路径；1217/1226 必须继续标记 CSI1000 provider floor partial。

decision.reason: 运行阻塞已经解除，A1 主窗口已产生可审计 perf；同窗比较显示 A1 CAGR -1.64%、Sharpe 0.073、MaxDD -56.95%，显著弱于 B0 CAGR 14.31%、Sharpe 0.663、MaxDD -35.42%。因此当前直接扩入 CSI1000 的股票池方案不建议推进。

evidence.note: PIT index history, provider floor, symbol counts, OHLCV coverage, ST/delist/listing and industry coverage audit.
Successful baseline stock-only run. CAGR 14.31%, Sharpe 0.663, MaxDD -35.42%, Calmar 0.404.
Docker run exited 137 with OOMKilled=true; only run_config.json exists, no perf.json or run_meta.json.
Safe optimizations accepted for B0 parity: CAGR/Sharpe/MaxDD/Calmar/trades/turnover unchanged versus exp_20260510_045702549_01ea; total runtime improved from 199.967s to 118.227s.
A1 was rerun after safe B0-parity optimizations and still exited 137/OOM before perf, run_meta, or run_profile were produced.
B0 parity after active-set sparse scoring and skip-pullback optimization. Metrics unchanged versus exp_20260510_054904100_3634; total runtime 132.58s, provider precompute 10.90s.
A1 main-window run completed after runtime optimization. Same effective execution start as B0: 2016-07-08. CAGR -1.64%, Sharpe 0.073, MaxDD -56.95%, Calmar -0.029.

notes.body: CSI1000 000852.SH has 3129 membership rows, 2690 distinct symbols, provider floor 2015-07-31, source tushare_csi1000_calendar, calendar version provisional-20260311-exact1000. CSI800 000906.SH has 5213 rows and 1996 distinct symbols.
B0 1626 profile: total 199.97s, symbols 1491, rows 6550634, data_load 79.36s, simulation 118.81s. A1 1626 exceeded container memory and was OOM killed before metrics.

Step 1 PIT interval row pushdown was rejected because B0 parity drifted. Steps 2 and 3 were accepted: stable top-k and skipping unused expensive scoring kept B0 metrics unchanged while reducing total wall time from 199.967s to 118.227s. Step 4 streaming rolling state remains a parity-gated helper, not a formal path replacement. A1 still OOM after safe optimizations.

Active-set sparse scoring plus skip unused pullback matrices resolved the A1 runtime blocker. B0 parity remained exact. A1 1626 completed but materially underperformed B0: CAGR -1.64% vs 14.31%, Sharpe 0.073 vs 0.663, MaxDD -56.95% vs -35.42%. Current CSI1000 direct pool expansion is rejected at main-window stage.

auto_summary.headline: HS300 + ZZ500 + CSI1000 PIT 股票池扩展：主变量=stock universe: HS300_ZZ500 -> HS300_ZZ500_CSI1000
auto_summary.conclusion_draft: 运行阻塞已解除，A1 主窗口已完成同窗对比，但直接扩入 CSI1000 后收益和风险显著恶化；当前结论是不建议推进该扩池方案，不升级 baseline，不接入组合腿。
facts: B0 主窗口已经产生可审计 perf。
A1 主窗口已经产生可审计 perf。
1626 union 股票池为 3318 只，较 B0 引入 1827 只 CSI1000 新增标的。
安全等价优化已通过 B0 parity，B0 总耗时从 199.967s 降至 118.227s。
PIT interval 行级裁剪未通过 B0 parity，已关闭。
Active-set sparse scoring 与跳过未启用 pullback 矩阵后，A1 1626 跑通。
risks: 主窗口同窗已经失败，不建议为了扩池继续直接跑升级链路。
CSI1000 新增标的明显拉低收益并放大回撤，需先做负贡献归因。
不能接受 naive PIT row pruning；它会破坏当前口径下的持仓估值或指标 warmup 语义。
1217/1226 涉及 CSI1000 2012-2015 provider floor 缺口，必须按 partial 处理。
宽股票池产物和内存规模可能污染后续全周期实验稳定性。
next_actions: 停止将当前 A1 作为 baseline 候选。
如继续研究，先做新增 CSI1000 标的负贡献归因。
1217/1226 只作为失败归因审计，不作为升级路径。
